block.ie_extras.analog_heater.tooltip: Electric heater for the crucible and other TFC heat devices: heats the block in front of its grille, like a forge heats a crucible above it.
block.ie_extras.analog_heater.tooltip.mo: Temperature follows redstone signal strength: 15 → %s °C (analog lever, comparator). FE from any face but the grille; up to %s FE/t at signal 15. Grille faces away from the player, Shift — towards. A comparator reads the temperature.
block.ie_extras.analog_heater.status.no_: Heater: %s °C, target %s °C (signal %s/15) — not enough energy, cooling (stored %s FE)
